prides.name: Ntsevu Pride
aliases: Mhangeni Breakaway Pride / Mhangeni Breakaways (until 29 Apr 2017)
Kambula Pride (the name Mala Mala used for the same pride, per 2024-03-21)
prides.status: active (post-2024 'Ntsevu' = smaller faction of 3 original lionesses plus Ndzhenga-sired cubs, mostly north of / east of the Sand River; still mating with Gijima Males in 2025-26)
prides.origin_summary: Six lionesses (plus three brothers) of the first Mhangeni litter (born 2013, sired by the Majingilane) who split from their mothers (the Mhangeni Pride) as sub-adults ~2015-16 and were renamed 'Ntsevu' ('six' in Shangaan) on 2017-04-29. Mhangeni -> Tsalala -> Castleton lineage. Mated with Matshipiri, Matimba, Majingilane then settled with the Birmingham Males (2018-2021), then Ndzhenga Males (Nov 2021-Aug 2025), then Gijima Males (from Aug 2025).

splits_and_takeovers.event: Mhangeni Breakaway pride formally renamed the Ntsevu Pride; six lionesses no longer rejoining the adult Mhangeni females.
Ntsevu pushed the Sparta pride out of the central/south-east range and killed one Sparta lioness.
Birmingham Males (4) become the Ntsevu's dominant/mating coalition (mating observed for months; first cubs 2018).
Ndzhenga Males (4) arrive in early Nov 2021; the surviving Birmingham Male is pushed out; Ntsevu mothers flee east/north with their 11 cubs, 7 lost.
11-12 sub-adults (6 males, 5-6 females; born mid-2018) leave the pride to become the Ntsevu Breakaway Pride.
Two Ntsevu mothers (the 'Ntsevu Two') reappear with the last 4 Birmingham-sired cubs, having broken away from the main pride after the Ndzhenga arrival.

Pride officially divided in two: smaller faction (3 original lionesses, living in northern Mala Mala) keeps the name Ntsevu; larger faction (1 original + 4/5 Birmingham-sired daughters + Ndzhenga-sired cubs) named Kambula Pride.
After the Gijima Males push north (Aug-Nov 2025), the 3-lioness Ntsevu Pride with 3 cubs follows the Ndzhenga Males north; one Gijima Male mates with a Ntsevu lioness (Aug, Sep, Nov 2025).

prides.notes: Pre-2024 blog posts use 'Ntsevu' for the whole pride (6 founding lionesses + cubs). From 24 Mar 2024 the name is restricted to the smaller faction. Counts of cubs/sub-adults conflict between posts (see open_questions).

prides.name: Kambula Pride
aliases: Ntsevu Pride (pre-2024 name for the same lions)
Kambula Breakaway Pride (the 2025 sub-adult faction + mentor lioness)
prides.status: active but fractured into three factions (Nov 2025 onward)
prides.origin_summary: Name given by Mala Mala to the Ntsevu Pride; officially adopted by Londolozi on 2024-03-21 for the larger faction of the old Ntsevu Pride after the Ndzhenga takeover: one founding Ntsevu lioness (born 2013) plus four-five daughters born 2018 (Birmingham-sired) and their Ndzhenga-sired cubs (Nov 2022-Aug 2023).

splits_and_takeovers.event: Created as a named pride when the old Ntsevu Pride was divided into 'Ntsevu' (3 originals) and 'Kambula' (1 original + 2018 daughters).
Pride 'at a crossroads': 11 sub-adults (7 males, 4 females) travel with one adult lioness; the other four lionesses raise two new litters (4 cubs + 2 cubs) separately.
Two adult lionesses deliberately isolate with six new cubs (Ndzhenga-sired) away from the sub-adults over ~10 months.

Pride formally described as three factions: (1) eldest lioness + 11 sub-adults heading into the Kruger; (2) two lionesses with 6 Ndzhenga-sired cubs; (3) two lionesses with new Gijima-sired litter(s) in the south-east.
Gijima Males take over the territory; Ndzhenga Males withdraw north; first Gijima-sired litter (4 cubs) discovered; one sub-adult male killed by Gijima Males.
One Kambula female reported to have lost her litter to the dark-maned Gijima Male; second female still nursing.
Two Kambula lionesses (the 'Gijima pair') give birth again in April 2026, denning together on the Sand River.
Kambula Pride and the two Gijima Males seen together with eight cubs.

prides.notes: 'Kambula Males' (= Ntsevu Breakaway Males) is a separate use of the name for the four young males that left the pride in 2021-22.

prides.name: Ntsevu Breakaway Pride
prides.status: dispersed: 4 males roam as a nomadic coalition (north to Manyelethi/Nkuhuma area and back); lone sister partnered with the Styx Male; 2 older males in Kruger NP
prides.origin_summary: Litter of 12 (6 males, 6 females) born to the Ntsevu lionesses, sired by the Birmingham Males, mid-2018 (plus a June-2019 litter of 4 from which a male and the breakaway female derive). Left the pride in 2021 and were scattered by the Ndzhenga arrival. Four older females rejoined their mothers (-> Kambula daughters); two younger females stayed with the brothers, later one (the 'breakaway female').

splits_and_takeovers.event: 11 sub-adults leave pride (males transitioning to nomads, females tagging along).
Six young males split into groups of three; Ndzhenga Males' arrival (Nov 2021) forced them southwest; sub-adult females largely rejoin mothers.
Original 12 split: oldest male in Kruger NP, second oldest between Kruger and Sabi Sand, four males + two younger females roam Sabi Sand; four older females rejoined mothers.
Six young males have all left the pride; two went NE into Kruger; the other four plus one 2019-born female roam the south-west.
The four males move north to the Manyelethi reserve and mate with Nkuhuma Pride lionesses.
Lone sister now with the Styx Young Male; brothers in the north.
Largest male injured Nov 2024 (possible run-in with Mantimahle Males) and temporarily separated; all four reunite by 26 Jan 2025.

prides.notes: Blog still calls them the 'Ntsevu Breakaways' in Jan 2025 and 'Kambula Males' in Nov 2024-Jul 2025.

prides.name: Mhangeni Pride
prides.status: active in the west of the Sabi Sand (Plains Camp Males, later Nkumati Coalition)
prides.origin_summary: Breakaway of the Tsalala Pride: the Original Tailless Female took four sub-adult (2009-born) lionesses, granddaughters not her own daughters, away from the Majingilane in 2010; they became the Mhangeni Pride. Context entry: only the lines that explain Ntsevu parentage and Mhangeni interactions are captured here.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Origin story: breakaway from Tsalala Pride six years earlier (2010).
Mhangeni Pride raises second batch; 12 cubs (9 male, 3 female) born between Oct 2015 and mid-2016; sub-adults pushed out end of 2017.
Othawa Male (~7 years old per post, but born early 2015 elsewhere) joins pride and becomes its dominant male.
Othawa Male dies (killed by Birmingham Males); Plains Camp Males later take over the Mhangeni females.
Nkumati Coalition (Nkuhuma + Talamati Males) acquire mating rights to the Mhangeni Pride.

prides.notes: Parent pride of the Ntsevu: 'Mhangeni females (mothers of Ntsevu females)'.

prides.name: Tsalala Pride
prides.status: reduced to a lone female (context entry; other agents cover this group in detail)
prides.origin_summary: Formed by two females breaking away from the Castleton Pride in 1998. Root of the Mhangeni lineage (and thus of the Ntsevu/Kambula lions): the Original Tailless Female -> Tsalala Sisters (Tailed and New Tailless females, born Dec 2002) -> the four 2009-born Mhangeni foundress lionesses.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Full pride history: Mhangeni Pride formed by the Original Tailless Female and four sub-adult lionesses (2009) after Majingilane arrival (2010), final separation Jan 2012.

prides.notes: Only included to anchor the Mhangeni/Ntsevu family tree.

prides.name: Msuthlu Pride
prides.status: active; one of the most-viewed prides on Londolozi 2025-26, now fragmenting (Sep 2026)
prides.origin_summary: Described as 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride' (2025-10-05). First met in 2022 in the north of the reserve (per 2026-04-04) and later settled in the far south of the Sabi Sand under the Gijima Males. Originally 4 adult lionesses and their offspring, 14 lions in total, younger members sired by the Gijima Males.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Gijima Males named as dominant over the Styx, Southern and Msuthlu prides; pride starts following them north.
Furthest north yet; kill a buffalo with the Gijima Males; Gijima Males named as fathers of the pride's cubs.

With the Ndzhenga and Gijima males swapping territory, Msuthlu become the 'resident pride roaming central Londolozi': 3 adult lionesses, 2 sub-adult males, 2 sub-adult females and 3 younger cubs seen most often.
Adult females come into heat and mate with the N'waswitsaka (Nwaswitshaka) Males in the south; 11 known members.
Pride no longer cohesive; Gijima Males moved north, Nwaswitshaka Males prominent in south; they harass a young Msuthlu male while two adult females defend him.

prides.notes: Exact link to the Talamati Pride (broke from Nkuhuma 2007) is only stated as 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride' in one post; see open_questions.

prides.name: Styx Pride
prides.origin_summary: Old pride of 14 lions at Londolozi in 2004 (Shaws Males took over Styx and Sparta prides in 2006). 2018-2020: visited Londolozi's north from the north-east, semi-nomadic by Aug 2020 after losing male cover. Later (2022) described as '3 adults and 11 cubs' established south of Londolozi, covered by the Ndzhenga Males who sired litters with them; by 2025 covered by the Gijima Males.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Styx pride semi-vagrant, without a dominant male; joined by one Nkuhuma young male.
Styx Pride: 3 adults, 11 cubs; moved south into old Ndzhenga territory, covered by Ndzhenga Males.
Ndzhenga Males had sired several litters with the Styx Pride before moving north.
Now dominated by the Gijima Males (along with Southern and Msuthlu prides).

prides.notes: 'Styx Male' (b. 2021) is a son of the Ndzhenga Males and a Styx-pride litter. Separate from the older 'Styx Males' coalition of 2014-15 and 'Styx Young Male (b.2016)' who broke away with an Nkuhuma young male.

prides.name: Southern Pride
prides.status: nearly extinct by 2021 (one adult female + 2 cubs); 2025 new offspring sired by Gijima Males
prides.origin_summary: Once the largest pride in the Sabi Sand (>10 adults), ranging across central-southern Sabi Sands. By April 2021 only one adult female and a wounded sub-adult remained on Londolozi's south; the sub-adult believed to have died soon after; adult female raising two cubs (~6 months old in Apr 2021).

splits_and_takeovers.event: Pride reduced to a single adult female; reported with 2 cubs.
Gijima Males protecting new offspring within the Southern Pride.
Gijima Males dominant over the Southern Pride.

prides.name: Sparta Pride
prides.status: context entry: reduced to two lionesses and cubs by 2017; displaced by the Ntsevu
prides.origin_summary: Iconic Londolozi pride (>20 lions in 2014) displaced from the central/south-east by the Matshipiri-aligned period and then by the Ntsevu Pride, which killed one Sparta lioness in Mar-Apr 2017.

splits_and_takeovers.event: A Sparta lioness is killed by the six Mhangeni Breakaway (Ntsevu) lionesses.
Ntsevu squeezed into the Sparta pride's old territory; Sparta reduced to two adults + 3 cubs, semi-nomadic.

prides.name: Talamati Pride
prides.origin_summary: Broke away from the Nkuhuma Pride in 2007; arrived on Londolozi April 2022 (2 adult lionesses, 2 young males, 4 females, Dark-maned Northern Avoca Male). Selati Males ruled it 2015-2019 and sired two daughters. The Msuthlu Pride is later described as the 'Talamati Breakaway Pride'.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Full origin story of the Talamati Pride incl. Matimba, Selati and Northern Avoca eras.

prides.notes: Included only to explain the Selati Males and the Msuthlu naming.

prides.name: Othawa Pride
prides.status: unknown; neighbouring western pride (2026: 'neighbouring Othawa and Ximungwe Prides')
prides.origin_summary: Only known as a western pride whose lionesses were mated by the Matimba Males in 2018 and later neighbours of the Mhangeni. The lone 'Othawa Male' shares the geographic name, but the posts do not explicitly say he was born into this pride.

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female (Tsalala)
individuals.birth_note: Born 1998 to one of the two females who broke from the Castleton Pride (the 'Two and Seven' cubs); sole survivor of the seven.
individuals.fate: Mauled by the Mhangeni lionesses (her granddaughters) at a zebra carcass in 2013; body found at Marthly Pools (suspected, 'mauled by the females').
individuals.father_or_sire_label: West Street Males (father of the Two-and-Seven cubs)
offspring_labels: Tsalala Sisters (Tailed and New Tailless females, born Dec 2002)
Cubs of 2005-2012 incl. her 12th cub in Aug 2012
individuals.notes: Lost her tail to hyenas in 2005. Led four 2009-born grand-daughters away from the Majingilane (2010); they became the Mhangeni Pride. Context only.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sister: 'Tailed Female'
individuals.birth_note: Born Dec 2002 at Ximpalapala Koppie, sired by the Marthly Males.
individuals.fate: Died early 2018 near Ximpalapala Koppie after the Tsalala pride fed on a dead elephant; condition had been deteriorating at ~15.
offspring_labels: Two of the four 2009-born Mhangeni foundress lionesses (twin daughters of the sisters, Mapogo-sired)
individuals.notes: Which sister mothered which 2009 cubs is not stated.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sister: 'New Tailless Female'
individuals.birth_note: Born Dec 2002; lost her tail to hyenas on 1 Nov 2011.
individuals.fate: Seriously injured ~May 2018 by the Ntsevu lionesses (her great-nieces / 'granddaughters' in the blog's wording); died at Marthly Pools within metres of where her mother died (per 2021-12-07).
offspring_labels: Two of the four 2009-born Mhangeni foundress lionesses (twin daughters of the sisters, Mapogo-sired)
individuals.notes: 2018-05-30 says she is the Tailed female's sister and that her injuries came from the Ntsevu lionesses, 'her granddaughters' (consistent with Ntsevu = daughters of the Mhangeni foundresses, who are daughters of the two Tsalala Sisters).

individuals.label: Mhangeni foundress lionesses (4 originals, born 2009)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2009 at Ximpalapala/Southern Cross area to the two Tsalala Sisters (two cubs each), sired by the Mapogo Males.
individuals.fate: Still alive in 2024 (two oldest, ~15 yrs, one toothless); some deaths over time (3 adults by Dec 2019, 2 originals by 2022-24).
offspring_labels: First Mhangeni litter (2013): 6 daughters (= Ntsevu founding lionesses) + 3 sons (Mhangeni males 2013)
Second litter 2015/16: 12 cubs (9M/3F), sired by the Majingilane
Later litters sired by Matimba/Birmingham/Othawa/Plains Camp/Nkumati
individuals.notes: Number of surviving founders: 4 adults (2015), 3 adults (2018-19, said to be '11 years old', born 2008 per 2019-12-02), 2 original lionesses in 2022-24 (aged ~15). Mated with Majingilane (2013), Birmingham (2018), Othawa Male (2019-21), Plains Camp (2021+). One original female left the pride in 2022 and briefly paired with the lone Tsalala Female.

individuals.label: Mhangeni males of the 2013 litter (three brothers of the Ntsevu lionesses)
aliases: Three young males of the Mhangeni breakaways
individuals.birth_note: Born 2013 in the first Mhangeni litter.
individuals.fate: Unknown; left with / after the sisters ~2016; 'went obscure' (2018-09-06). One Talamati male and a Sparta young male associated with them briefly.
individuals.notes: 'Three young males had split off' from the six breakaway females in late 2016.

individuals.label: Sparta young male who joined the Mhangeni (2015)
individuals.birth_note: One of the three Sparta males of 2012 chased by the Majingilane on 16 Jul 2015.
individuals.fate: Disappeared from the Mhangeni breakaways in late 2015 (fate unknown).
individuals.notes: Attached to the Mhangeni, then to the Mhangeni breakaways.

individuals.label: Talamati young male with the Mhangeni breakaways (2016)
individuals.birth_note: Son of the Matimba Males (per 2016-08-20).
individuals.fate: Left/unknown.
individuals.notes: Separated from his brothers by the Charleston males; tolerated by the Matimba and shadowed the breakaway females.

individuals.label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (6, born 2013)
individuals.birth_note: Born Sept 2013 (first Mhangeni litter of 9-10 cubs; 6 females + 3 males survived).
individuals.fate: Two original lionesses lost in early/mid-2023 (unknown circumstances); 4 originals by mid-2023: 3 in Ntsevu Pride + 1 in Kambula Pride; at least one barren.
individuals.notes: Independent from ~2015-16; named Ntsevu 2017. Individuals are not named; identified as 'the lioness at the back with pale fur and ridge on her nose' etc.

individuals.label: Ntsevu lioness suspected infertile / 'barren' lioness
individuals.birth_note: One of the founding six.
individuals.fate: Alive in Aug 2024 as the 'barren godmother' of the Ntsevu cubs.
individuals.notes: 2019-11/2020-03 posts: not pregnant despite repeated Birmingham mating; mated with the Othawa Male Mar 2020. 2020-08-18 reported she may have given birth to two cubs; 2024-08-15 says she has 'never been able to fall pregnant' - contradiction.

individuals.label: Ntsevu mothers who fled north in 2021 ('Ntsevu Two plus Two')
individuals.birth_note: Two of the founding six.
individuals.fate: Became the core of the new smaller 'Ntsevu Pride' (3 originals) by Mar 2024.
offspring_labels: The last 4 Birmingham-sired cubs of Oct 2021 (2 survivors by mid-2022)
individuals.notes: Fled the Ndzhenga arrival from Oct 2021 and came back 24 Mar 2022 with 4 cubs; 3 originals formed the Ntsevu faction.

individuals.label: Kambula Pride's lone 2013-born lioness (eldest; mentor to the sub-adults)
individuals.birth_note: One of the 2013 founding Ntsevu females.
individuals.fate: Alive Mar 2026; left with 11 sub-adults towards Kruger NP (Nov 2025).
individuals.notes: 2025-07-14: 'one of the founding lionesses was born in 2013, the others are from a 2018 litter.' 2025-08-19 / 2025-11-19: fifth lioness stayed with sub-adults as matriarch. Identity with the 2013-born lioness is inferred.

individuals.label: Two Ntsevu founding lionesses lost in 2023
individuals.birth_note: Two of the six founders.
individuals.fate: Died / lost in the first half of 2023 for unknown reasons (2023-07-19: one mother of 4 cubs and one with 5 cubs 'died').
individuals.notes: 2023-06-19 says two 2013 lionesses lost at 'beginning of 2023'; 2024-03-21 says 'mid-2023'.

individuals.label: Ntsevu lioness with two daughters who bit her sister's cub (2023)
individuals.birth_note: One of the original six.
individuals.fate: Alive 2023.
individuals.notes: Kept cubs separate from the pride for months; seriously wounded a cub of her sister's litter (cub missing afterwards). A younger female seen with her may be a daughter from an earlier litter (inferred).

individuals.label: Early Ntsevu litters (2017-2018) - all failed
individuals.birth_note: Litters in early 2017, Jan 2018, Apr 2018 (3 cubs).
individuals.fate: No survivors: one litter killed by its sires (Birmingham), one killed by a female within the pride, others vanished.
individuals.notes: 2018-09-09: 'One litter was killed by the very males that sired them (Birmingham), and another litter was killed by a female within the pride.'

individuals.label: Ntsevu 2018 sub-adults / cubs (first successful litters)
individuals.birth_note: Born from ~Aug 2018 (litters of 3,3,5 and others; 15 cubs presumed, 11 seen by Nov 2019; counts vary); sired by the Birmingham Males.
individuals.fate: 11-12 survived to sub-adulthood (6 male, 5-6 female); later split into the Breakaway males and the Kambula daughters.
individuals.mother_id_or_label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (5 of 6 gave birth)
offspring_labels: Two older young males in Kruger NP

individuals.label: Ntsevu Breakaway Males (4): the Ntsevu / Kambula Males
individuals.birth_note: Three born 2018 and one male (with the female) born 2019 (2023-09-04).
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2025; roaming north/south-east; one (largest) injured Nov 2024 and rejoined Jan 2025.
individuals.notes: Alias Kambula Males (Oct 2024-Jul 2025). Mated with Nkuhuma Pride lionesses in the north (Sept 2024).

individuals.label: Ntsevu Breakaway female (the 'Kambula Breakaway lioness')
individuals.fate: Alive Apr 2026, paired with the Styx Male.
individuals.notes: Separated from brothers by Oct 2024; companion of the Styx Male (Oct 2024-Apr 2026) hunting buffalo; 2025-06-12 and 2025-08-17 call her the 'Kambula Breakaway Lioness'. No cubs reported.

individuals.label: Two older Ntsevu young males (went to Kruger NP)
individuals.birth_note: Oldest of the 6 males.
individuals.fate: Moved to / between Kruger NP and Sabi Sand by Aug 2022; two in Kruger by mid-2023.
individuals.notes: 'Oldest young male spending time in Kruger; second oldest bouncing between Kruger and Sabi Sands.'

individuals.label: Kambula daughters (born 2018): 4-5 adult lionesses of the Kambula Pride
individuals.birth_note: Born mid-2018, Birmingham-sired; rejoined their mothers in 2022.
individuals.fate: Alive 2026; two raising Ndzhenga-sired cubs, two Gijima-sired.
individuals.notes: Count disagrees: 2024-03-21 'five female offspring'; 2024-04-11 five lionesses in total; 2025-01-21 'four females from the same litter'; 2025-07-14 one 2013-born + 2018 litter = five adult lionesses.

individuals.label: Ntsevu litter of four (June 2019)
individuals.birth_note: Born June 2019; late litter.
individuals.fate: Presumably part of the sub-adults; one male + the female later in the breakaway group.
individuals.notes: 2019-11-23: 'a late litter of four cubs born in June 2019'; inferred that the 2019-born male and female of the breakaway group derive from it.

individuals.label: Ntsevu newest cub (Aug-Oct 2020)
individuals.birth_note: Less than 8 weeks old on 22 Oct 2020; also 'two cubs' reported Aug 2020.
individuals.fate: Unknown.
individuals.notes: May be the child of the formerly 'infertile' lioness.

individuals.label: Ntsevu cubs of April / October 2021 (Birmingham-sired)
individuals.birth_note: April 2021: litter of 5 (found 7 Apr 2021); Oct 2021: more litters; 11 cubs in total at Dec 2021-Mar 2022.
individuals.fate: 7 of 11 lost after the Ndzhenga arrival (Nov 2021); 4 survivors Mar 2022; 2 left by Aug 2022.
individuals.notes: 2022-04-11: 'last four cubs of the Birmingham Coalition'; 2022-08-03: youngest lost, another lost, 2 left. 2022-01-10 describes April-born cubs of 5 with only 3 left; dating of litters differs among posts.

individuals.label: Last two surviving Birmingham-sired Ntsevu cubs (2021 litter)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~Oct 2021 (partly).
individuals.fate: Still with 'Ntsevu Two' in Nov 2022; one sub-adult in 2024 caption 'two remaining youngsters'.
individuals.notes: Names unspecified.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga-sired Ntsevu/Kambula cubs of Nov 2022 - Apr 2023 (the 'Kambula sub-adults')
individuals.birth_note: 21-24 cubs born Nov 2022 - Apr 2023 (litters of 3, 5, etc.); eight Ntsevu lionesses gave birth; 12 left by Jul 2023 (>=5 F, 8 M?), 13 cubs in Apr 2024 and 12 sub-adults (8M/4F) in Feb 2025; 11 (7M/4F) by Jul 2025.
individuals.fate: 11 sub-adults travelled with the eldest lioness into the Kruger NP side in late 2025; one young male killed by the Gijima Males in Nov 2025 (counts contradictory).
individuals.notes: Count details: 2023-06-19 '21 cubs...12 remain'; 2023-07-19 '24 cubs...12 to 16 remain; at least five F and eight M'; 2024-04-11 '13 cubs'; 2025-02-20 '12 subadults, 8M 4F'; 2025-07-14 '11 sub-adults, 7M 4F'.

individuals.label: Kambula sub-adult male killed by Gijima Males
individuals.birth_note: Born mid-2022 to early 2023.
individuals.fate: Killed by the Gijima Males during their takeover (autumn 2025); 'caught by surprise'.
individuals.notes: The blog still lists 7 males after the death, so the count conflicts.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga-sired Ntsevu Pride cubs (Nov 2023 trio; May 2024 four)
individuals.birth_note: Trio (1M,2F) born Nov 2023 (2024-08-15) or early Aug 2023 (2023-12-17, first seen Oct 2023); four (1M,3F) born May 2024.
individuals.fate: Four-cub litter lost (Apr 2025); trio ~1y4m old in Apr 2025 and 'three cubs' accompanying the Ntsevu Pride north in Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: Born in northern Mala Mala/Sand River. A sub-adult male with the 3 lionesses in Jun 2026 may be the Nov 2023 male (inferred).

individuals.label: Six Ndzhenga-sired Kambula cubs of 2025 (litters of 4 and 2)
individuals.birth_note: Four cubs (3M,1F) born ~early Feb 2025 in thickets on the Maxabene near the Sand River confluence; second litter of two later in 2025 (six cubs total).
individuals.fate: All 6 still alive as of 30 Dec 2025 and ~1 year old in Apr 2026 (one report 5 cubs on 31 Dec 2025).
individuals.notes: 2025-03-12 confirmed '3 males and 1 female' of the four.

individuals.label: Kambula cubs of Nov 2025 (Gijima-sired)
individuals.birth_note: Four cubs found 14 Nov 2025 (a few days old), second pregnant lioness probably also gave birth.
individuals.fate: Litter lost to the dark-maned Gijima Male by 28 Dec 2025 (infanticide); other litter status unclear.
individuals.notes: Disagreement: 2025-12-28 says 'one Kambula female lost her litter to dark-maned Gijima male'; 2026-04-04 says both lost their newest cubs.

individuals.label: Kambula cubs of April 2026 (Gijima-sired, 8 cubs)
individuals.birth_note: One cub ~10 days old seen 12 Apr 2026; eight cubs from two lionesses by Jul-Aug 2026.
individuals.fate: All eight alive Aug 2026.
individuals.notes: Dens shared on the Sand River.

individuals.label: Kambula lioness pair that stayed behind / mated with Gijima Males
individuals.birth_note: Probably the 2018 daughters.
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2026.
offspring_labels: Apr 2026 cubs (8 with the other pair)
individuals.notes: They hung back when the others followed the Ndzhenga Males north.

individuals.label: Kambula lioness pair with the six Ndzhenga-sired cubs
individuals.birth_note: Probably the 2018 daughters.
individuals.fate: Alive 2026.
individuals.notes: Followed the Ndzhenga Males north to avoid Gijima Males.

individuals.label: Msuthlu adult lionesses (4)
individuals.birth_note: Not stated.
individuals.fate: 3 seen most Apr 2026, 4 again Sep 2026; 4th and one subadult seen further south.
individuals.notes: Pride described as 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride'. A sub-adult was killed by the Nkhulu Males late 2025.

individuals.label: Msuthlu sub-adults / young (11-14 lions in total incl. adults)
individuals.birth_note: Offspring of the four adults, sired by the Gijima Males; e.g. 2 sub-adult males, 2 young sub-adult females, 3 younger cubs seen Apr 2026.
individuals.fate: A young male harassed by the Nwaswitshaka Males in Aug-Sep 2026 - fate unknown.
individuals.notes: 2026-09-01: roughly seven sub-adults remain.

open_questions: COVERAGE GAP: 'The Styx Male: A Growing Presence' (2026-09-05) is not in the local corpus (latest file is 2026-09-01); Styx Male data comes from 2024-10 to 2026-07 posts only.

COVERAGE GAP: No saved post mentions 'Eyrefield'. 'Selati' appears in only three posts (2019-07-31, 2019-08-15, 2022-07-25); 'Southern Pride' in five (2019-09-05, 2020-03-24, 2021-04-06, 2025-06-12, 2025-09-22).

Date of Mhangeni formation: 2010 (2016-04-18, 2016-09-07), 'late 2011-Jan 2012' (2021-12-07, final separation after the Jan 2012 flood), or named only when cubs arrived in 2013 (2016-09-03). Posts of 2024-06-10 say the Ntsevu 'broke away to form the Ntsevu Pride in 2015'; 2017-04-29 / 2017-11-06 say 2016-17.

Paternity of the 2013 Mhangeni cubs and the 2015-16 litter: stated as Majingilane (2018-02-27, 2018-11-08, 2016-05-10) - but 2017-01-09 says Mhangeni Breakaway cubs were believed sired by the Matimba males and 2017-04-29 says those litters failed. The 2024-06-10 post conflates 'offspring from this litter' (2013) with Ntsevu forming in 2015.

Mhangeni foundresses' birth year: 2009 (2021-12-07, 2022-09-19, 2024-06-10) vs 2008 (2019-12-02); '11 years old' in Dec 2019 implies 2008. Their sires are the Mapogo per 2021-12-07/2024-06-10 - but 2019-12-02 does not say.

Number of 2013 founders still alive: 6 original Ntsevu lionesses; 2 lost early/mid 2023 (2023-06-19, 2024-03-21), 3 in the Ntsevu faction (2024-03-21), 1 in the Kambula faction. 2023-07-19 says two mothers (4 cubs and 5 cubs) 'died', consistent with the loss but not proven to be the same two.

Kambula Pride composition: 2024-03-21 'last original lioness + five female offspring' (6 total) vs 2024-04-11 'five lionesses' vs 2025-01-21 'four females from the same litter' vs 2025-07-14 'five adult lionesses'. Likely 1 original + 4 daughters = 5, but unresolved.

Cub counts for the 2018 Birmingham-sired litters and sub-adults vary: 15 presumed (2018-11), 13 (2019-01), 11 + 4 (2019-11), 11 (2021-08, 5M/6F), 11 (2022-05, 5F/6M), 12 (6M/6F, 2022-08), 10 (2021-08), 12 with 8 males/3 females (2019-11). Sex ratios disagree.

Counts for the Ndzhenga-sired 2022-23 cohort: 21 cubs (2023-06-19), 24 (2023-07-19), 12 remain (Jul 2023), 13 (Apr 2024), 12 sub-adults 8M/4F (Feb 2025), 11 sub-adults 7M/4F (Jul and Nov 2025, even after a male was killed).
Sub-adult male killed by the Gijima Males (Nov 2025): the blog still lists 7 young males after the death in 2025-11-19, so either the kill happened before the 11 count or the count was not updated.

Ntsevu lioness thought infertile: 2020-08-18 says she may have given birth to two cubs; 2024-08-15 says she is barren and has 'never been able to fall pregnant'. Which of the six is the barren one is never stated.

Date of Ntsevu trio litter: 2023-12-17 says early August 2023 (first seen 23 Oct 2023) vs 2024-08-15 says 'November 2023' (1 male, 2 females). The 5-cub litter of 2021-04 vs 5 born 'in April this year' (2022-01-10) and 11 cubs born 'early October 2021' (2022-04-11) also differ in timing.

The 'last Birmingham cubs' (2021 litter): 2022-04 four survive; 2022-08 two survive; 2024-03 caption 'the 2 remaining youngsters'. Their sexes are never given; whether the pair belongs to the Ntsevu Pride proper is unclear.
Birmingham Males: 5 original (2022-08-03, 2019-08-15), 6 (2021-06-22), 4 in 2018, 3 in early 2019, 2 by Dec 2019, 1 by Nov 2021; date and cause of the death of the first male is not given.

Ndzhenga and Gijima: 2023-06-19 says the S79 Ndzhenga male was injured by the Gijima Males in April 2022; 2025-08-21 says the Ndzhenga 'killed the third Gijima Male' months after arriving; does that refer to a fight in late 2021/early 2022?

Msuthlu Pride origin: described as 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride' (2025-10-05) and 'first met in 2022' (2026-04-04), yet 2026-04-04 says all 14 lions were sired by the Gijima Males. It is unclear whether the 2022 Talamati Pride sub-adult females (daughters of the Northern Avoca Males) are the Msuthlu adults.

Sire of the Styx Male: 2025-02-20 says one of the Ndzhenga Males is 'actually his father'; 2022-11-10 says Ndzhenga Males sired litters with the Styx Pride but Styx Male b. 2021 pre-dates their arrival at Londolozi (Nov 2021) - plausible only if they were consorting in 2020-21 as the posts suggest. His mother is never named.
Whether the Ntsevu Breakaway Female's mother is any specific lioness: 2024-10-02 says she is 'the daughter of the one female in the Pride', an unclear phrase, so no maternal link is asserted.

Othawa Male: age at 2019-12-02 ('about seven years old') conflicts with 2018-09-17 (3.5 years) and 2021-01-09 (born early 2015). Exact death date not given (between Jun 2021 and Nov 2021). Origin pride unknown.
Whether 'Othawa lionesses' (2018-05-07) are the same as the 'Othawa Pride' of 2026-02-12 is not stated.

Relationship of the Original Tailless Female and the Tailless/Tailed 'Tsalala Sisters' to other agent groups (Tsalala data) is only captured at the level needed to anchor the Mhangeni lineage; consult the Tsalala file for details.
The 'Southern Pride' lioness's cubs (b. ~Oct 2020) fate and the sire of those cubs are unstated; the 2025 'new offspring' are said to be protected by the Gijima Males.
